name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: GDACS red alert for Cyclone Murasu heading for India's east coast
state: GDACS kept a red alert for Cyclone Murasu in the Bay of Bengal on 1 Nov. At 12:00 UTC it was about 383km east of Chennai with sustained winds of 93km/h, moving west-northwest at 26km/h towards the coast of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu (RainViewer). Typhoon In-Fa near Japan remains at a lower alert level.
for_you: Anyone in coastal Andhra Pradesh or Tamil Nadu should follow India Meteorological Department and local authority warnings; travellers can check FCDO advice.

sources.title: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
